"""Inspect an exact existing stage, then finish only with a fresh source card."""

sys.path.insert(0, str(SUPPORT))
import publish_exact_once_a01 as p

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
W = Path('C:/ck3-e04-resume-20261020-a01/r06-resume-a02/integration-worktree')
D = Path('D:/workspace/ck3_eternal_recurrence')
BASE = '7e5b2ea60cb7634239ffb8c00fb3495af41d4ac7'

RAW = 'docs/ck3-native-ai/evidence/episode04-ci-refill-reviewer-fixture-20261021/raw/'
TARGET = 'docs/ck3-native-ai/evidence/episode04-ci-refill-reviewer-fixture-20261021/finish-0415/'
OLD = p.Pin(SUPPORT.parent / 'EXACT-COPYPLAN.prepared-a02.json', 25011,
            '20fa5f72cd2df9a88524b79660e52e8695761f167129952f160c52699ef20f69')
SUPPORT_SHA = '26eaea0ee792836878bb2059f20b2796e097a90509e6dbad9158e61da94ed0e2'
ROOT_LIMIT = 2097152
LOG_LIMIT = 262144


def pin_document(pin: p.Pin) -> dict[str, p.Json]:
    return {'path': str(pin.path), 'bytes': pin.size, 'sha256': pin.sha256}


def save(name: str, value: dict[str, p.Json]) -> p.Pin:
    p.need('/' not in name and '\\' not in name, 'new-root metadata basename')
    data = (json.dumps({'machine_id': MACHINE, 'observed_at_utc': p.now().isoformat(), **value},
                       ensure_ascii=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode()
    p.need(p.census(ROOT) + len(data) <= ROOT_LIMIT, 'new root C2 limit')
    path = ROOT / name
    with path.open('xb') as stream:
        stream.write(data)
    return p.Pin(path, len(data), p.sha(data))


def parse_headers(data: bytes, items: tuple[p.Item, ...]) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    p.need(len(data) <= LOG_LIMIT and bool(data), 'bounded nonempty staged diagnostic')
    by_name = {item.target: item for item in items}
    found: set[str] = set()
    for line in data.decode('utf-8', errors='strict').splitlines():
        if line.startswith('+'):
            continue
        match = re.fullmatch(r'(.+):([1-9][0-9]*): (trailing whitespace|new blank line at EOF|space before tab in indent)\.', line)
        p.need(match is not None, 'unparsed staged diagnostic header: ' + line[:180])
        if match is None:
            raise ValueError('diagnostic header')
        name = match.group(1)
        p.need(name in by_name and name.startswith(RAW), 'diagnostic outside exact original immutable raw: ' + name)
        p.need(by_name[name].old is None, 'diagnostic targets an existing canonical file')
        found.add(name)
    p.need(bool(found), 'no actual immutable raw diagnostic paths')
    return tuple(sorted(found))


def require_names(data: bytes, items: tuple[p.Item, ...]) -> None:
    actual = data.decode('utf-8').split('\0')
    p.need(actual[-1] == '', 'NUL stage terminator')
    names = actual[:-1]
    p.need(len(names) == len(set(names)) and set(names) == {item.target for item in items},
           'exact staged names differ; no replay')


def json_item(value: object) -> p.Item:
    item = p.Item.parse(value)
    p.need(item.old is None and item.target.startswith(TARGET) and item.target.endswith('.json'),
           'only new exact LF JSON supplements')
    data = item.source.read()
    p.need(b'\r' not in data and data.endswith(b'\n') and p.blob(data) == item.git_blob, 'supplement must be original LF bytes')
    row = p.obj(json.loads(data, object_pairs_hook=p.unique_pairs), 'supplement JSON')
    p.need(row.get('machine_id') == MACHINE, 'supplement machine')
    return item


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Recipe:
    pin: p.Pin
    supplements: tuple[p.Item, ...]
    exceptions: tuple[str, ...]
    diagnostic: p.Pin
    integrity: p.Pin

    @staticmethod
    def parse(pin: p.Pin) -> Recipe:
        row = p.obj(json.loads(pin.read(), object_pairs_hook=p.unique_pairs), 'finish recipe')
        p.need(row.get('schema') == 'xar.e04.exact-staged-finish.recipe.v1', 'finish recipe schema')
        p.need(row.get('machine_id') == MACHINE and row.get('expected_HEAD') == BASE, 'recipe machine/HEAD')
        p.need(p.Pin.parse(row.get('old_plan'), 'old plan') == OLD, 'fixed original52 plan')
        values = row.get('supplements')
        names = row.get('exact_raw_whitespace_exceptions')
        p.need(isinstance(values, list) and len(values) == 4, 'four fixed metadata supplements')
        p.need(isinstance(names, list), 'exact exception names')
        supplements: list[p.Item] = []
        exceptions: list[str] = []
        if isinstance(values, list):
            supplements = [json_item(value) for value in values]
        if isinstance(names, list):
            exceptions = [p.target_name(name) for name in names]
        p.need(exceptions == sorted(set(exceptions)), 'canonical exact exception list')
        own = json_item({'source': str(pin.path), 'bytes': pin.size, 'sha256': pin.sha256,
                         'target': TARGET+'FINISH-RECIPE.prepared-a01.json',
                         'git_blob': p.blob(pin.read()), 'old': None})
        return Recipe(pin, (*supplements, own), tuple(exceptions),
                      p.Pin.parse(row.get('actual_full_staged_diagnostic'), 'actual diagnostic'),
                      p.Pin.parse(row.get('old52_integrity'), 'old52 integrity'))


class Runner:
    def __init__(self, card: p.Pin, execution: bool) -> None:
        p.need(p.sha((SUPPORT / 'publish_exact_once_a01.py').read_bytes()) == SUPPORT_SHA, 'reviewed support bytes')
        self.card = card
        self.frozen: list[p.Pin] = [OLD]
        self.cap = p.obj(json.loads(card.read(), object_pairs_hook=p.unique_pairs), 'source card')
        p.need(self.cap.get('machine_id') == MACHINE and self.cap.get('budget_status') == 'GREEN', 'fresh GREEN machine')
        p.truth(self.cap.get('admitted'), 'admitted')
        self.deadline = p.timestamp(self.cap.get('hard_deadline_utc'), 'deadline')
        self.execution = execution
        self.plan = p.Plan.parse(OLD)
        p.need(len(self.plan.items) == 52 and self.plan.base == BASE, 'fixed known52 stage')
        self.records = p.Recorder(ROOT / ('execution' if execution else 'inspection'), MACHINE)
        self.sequence = 0
        self.phase = 'initial'
        self.counts = {'old_copy': 0, 'old_stage': 0, 'supplement_stage': 0, 'commit': 0, 'push': 0}
        self.w_baseline = p.integer(self.cap.get('W_baseline_bytes'), 'W baseline')
        if execution:
            for key in ('Git_mutation_execution_admitted', 'finish_known_staged_execution_admitted', 'new_JSON_stage_execution_admitted',
                        'commit_execution_admitted', 'push_execution_admitted'):
                p.truth(self.cap.get(key), key)
            for key in ('repeat_old52_copy_stage_admitted', 'copy_execution_admitted', 'stage_execution_admitted'):
                p.need(self.cap.get(key) is False, 'old copy/stage must remain false')
            p.need(self.cap.get('expected_W_and_remote') == BASE, 'exact current HEAD card')
            p.need(Path(p.text(self.cap.get('W'), 'W')).resolve() == W.resolve() and
                   Path(p.text(self.cap.get('D'), 'D')).resolve() == D.resolve(), 'canonical roots')
            source = p.Pin.parse(self.cap.get('executor'), 'executor')
            p.need(source.path == Path(__file__).resolve(), 'executor path')
            source.read()
            self.frozen.append(source)
        else:
            p.truth(self.cap.get('source_and_focused_checks_admitted'), 'source inspection admitted')
            p.need(self.cap.get('Git_mutation_execution_admitted') is False, 'inspection has no Git writes')

    def guard(self, mutation: bool = False) -> None:
        self.card.read()
        for pin in self.frozen:
            pin.read()
        p.need(p.now() < self.deadline, 'finite phase expired')
        p.need(p.census(ROOT) <= ROOT_LIMIT, 'metadata root C2 bound')
        if mutation:
            p.need(self.execution, 'mutation forbidden in inspection')
            p.need(p.census(ROOT) + max(0, p.census(W) - self.w_baseline) <= ROOT_LIMIT, 'C2 inclusive W/metadata bound')

    def git(self, where: Path, args: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        return ['git', '--no-optional-locks', '--no-lazy-fetch', '-c', 'gc.auto=0', '-c',
                'maintenance.auto=false', '-c', 'index.version=4', '-C', str(where), *args]

    def command(self, label: str, argv: list[str], payload: bytes | None = None,
                allowed: tuple[int, ...] = (0,), mutation: bool = False) -> bytes:
        self.guard(mutation)
        self.sequence += 1
        prefix = f'{self.sequence:02d}-' + label
        env = os.environ.copy()
        env.update(GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS='0', GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH='1', PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1')
        child: subprocess.Popen[bytes] = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=W, env=env,
            stdin=subprocess.PIPE if payload is not None else subprocess.DEVNULL,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW)

        def started(birth: str) -> None:
            self.records.put(prefix+'.CREATED.actual.json', {'pid': child.pid,
                'creation_filetime_decimal': birth, 'argv': argv, 'mutation': mutation})

        result = p.own_wait(child, payload, p.creation_filetime, started)
        self.records.put(prefix+'.ORIGINAL-WAIT.actual.json', {'pid': result.pid,
            'creation_filetime_decimal': result.created, 'actual_original_popen_wait': True,
            'argv': argv, 'mutation': mutation, 'returncode': result.code, 'owner_errors': list(result.errors),
            'stdout_bytes': len(result.stdout), 'stdout_sha256': p.sha(result.stdout),
            'stderr_bytes': len(result.stderr), 'stderr_sha256': p.sha(result.stderr),
            'stderr_prefix': result.stderr[:2048].decode(errors='replace')})
        p.need(result.code in allowed and not result.errors, 'command failed, no replay: '+label)
        data: object = result.stdout
        if isinstance(data, bytes):
            return data
        raise ValueError('original owner stdout bytes')

    def verify_stage(self, items: tuple[p.Item, ...], label: str) -> str:
        require_names(self.command(label+'-names', self.git(W, ['diff', '--cached', '--name-only', '-z'])), items)
        data = self.command(label+'-blobs', self.git(W, ['cat-file', '--batch']),
                            ('\n'.join(':'+item.target for item in items)+'\n').encode())
        result: object = p.parse_batch(data, items)
        if isinstance(result, str):
            return result
        raise ValueError('stage proof digest')

    def common(self) -> None:
        self.guard()
        p.need(self.command('machine', [sys.executable, '-B', str(D/'tools/ck3_live_run_id.py'), 'machine']).decode().strip() == MACHINE,
               'actual machine')
        p.need(self.command('HEAD', self.git(W, ['rev-parse', 'HEAD'])).decode().strip() == BASE, 'HEAD drift')
        p.need(self.command('remote', self.git(W, ['ls-remote', 'origin', 'refs/heads/master'])).decode().split() == [BASE, 'refs/heads/master'],
               'remote drift STOP')
        p.need(not self.command('unstaged', self.git(W, ['diff', '--name-only'])), 'unstaged files')
        p.need(not self.command('untracked', self.git(W, ['ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard'])), 'untracked files')
        p.need(self.command('D-HEAD', self.git(D, ['rev-parse', 'HEAD'])).decode().strip() == DHEAD, 'frozen D HEAD')
        p.need(not self.command('D-clean', self.git(D, ['status', '--porcelain=v1', '--untracked-files=no'])), 'frozen D dirty')
        for number, item in enumerate(self.plan.items):
            item.source.read()
            if item.old is not None:
                data = self.command('preimage-'+str(number), self.git(W, ['show', BASE+':'+item.target]))
                p.need(len(data) == item.old.size and p.sha(data) == item.old.sha256 and p.blob(data) == item.old.git_blob,
                       'canonical preimage mismatch')
        p.need(not self.command('new-target-preimages-absent', self.git(W, ['ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', BASE,
            '--', *[item.target for item in self.plan.items if item.old is None]])), 'new original targets existed at HEAD')
        index_path = Path('D:/workspace/ck3_eternal_recurrence/.git/worktrees/integration-worktree/index')
        p.need(not index_path.with_name('index.lock').exists(), 'index writer exists')
        p.require_index_v4(index_path.read_bytes()[:8])

    def full_diagnostic(self) -> tuple[bytes, tuple[str, ...]]:
        data = self.command('full-staged-default-check', self.git(W, ['diff', '--cached', '--check']), allowed=(2,))
        return data, parse_headers(data, self.plan.items)

    def clean_check(self, exceptions: tuple[str, ...]) -> None:
        self.command('nonexempt-default-check', self.git(W, ['diff', '--cached', '--check', '--', '.',
                     *[':(exclude,literal)'+name for name in exceptions]]))

    def inspect(self) -> None:
        self.common()
        table = self.verify_stage(self.plan.items, 'old52')
        raw, names = self.full_diagnostic()
        self.clean_check(names)
        output = ROOT / 'FULL-STAGED-DEFAULT-CHECK.stdout.actual.txt'
        p.need(p.census(ROOT)+len(raw) < ROOT_LIMIT, 'diagnostic fits C2')
        with output.open('xb') as stream:
            stream.write(raw)
        diagnostic = p.Pin(output, len(raw), p.sha(raw))
        index = Path('D:/workspace/ck3_eternal_recurrence/.git/worktrees/integration-worktree/index').read_bytes()
        save('OLD52-INTEGRITY.actual-a01.json', {'schema': 'xar.e04.known52-stage-integrity.v1',
            'old_plan': pin_document(OLD), 'HEAD': BASE, 'old52_count': 52, 'ordered_blob_table_sha256': table,
            'source_and_index_all_original_bytes_equal': True, 'preimages_verified': True,
            'actual_index_bytes': len(index), 'actual_index_sha256': p.sha(index), 'index_version': 4,
            'Git_mutations': 0, 'owned_processes': []})
        save('EXACT-WHITESPACE-EXCEPTIONS.actual-a01.json', {'schema': 'xar.e04.known52-whitespace.v1',
            'old_plan': pin_document(OLD), 'actual_full_staged_diagnostic': pin_document(diagnostic),
            'paths': list(names), 'all_headers_parsed': True, 'every_path_old_plan_new_immutable_raw': True,
            'path_bindings': [{'target': item.target, 'source': pin_document(item.source), 'git_blob': item.git_blob}
                              for item in self.plan.items if item.target in names],
            'nonexempt_default_check_passed': True, 'core_whitespace_changed': False})

    def finish(self) -> None:
        recipe = Recipe.parse(p.Pin.parse(self.cap.get('finish_recipe'), 'finish recipe'))
        root_pin = p.Pin.parse(self.cap.get('Root_adoption'), 'Root adoption')
        self.frozen.extend([recipe.pin, recipe.diagnostic, recipe.integrity, root_pin])
        adoption = p.obj(json.loads(root_pin.read(), object_pairs_hook=p.unique_pairs), 'external Root adoption')
        p.need(adoption.get('machine_id') == MACHINE, 'external Root adoption machine')
        supplements = recipe.supplements
        p.need(len(supplements) <= 6 and len({item.target for item in supplements}) == len(supplements), 'at most six unique supplements')
        self.records.put('CLAIM.actual.json', {'maximum_commit': 1, 'maximum_push': 1,
            'old52_copy_stage': False, 'maximum_new_JSON': 6})
        self.common()
        original_table = self.verify_stage(self.plan.items, 'old52-before')
        prior = p.obj(json.loads(recipe.integrity.read(), object_pairs_hook=p.unique_pairs), 'integrity')
        p.need(prior.get('ordered_blob_table_sha256') == original_table, 'known original52 proof drift')
        raw, names = self.full_diagnostic()
        p.need(names == recipe.exceptions and p.sha(raw) == recipe.diagnostic.sha256 and len(raw) == recipe.diagnostic.size,
               'actual staged diagnostic changed')
        recipe.diagnostic.read()
        self.clean_check(names)
        self.phase = 'new-supplements'
        for item in supplements:
            destination = W / item.target
            p.need(not destination.exists(), 'supplement target already exists')
            self.guard(True)
            destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            with destination.open('xb') as stream:
                stream.write(item.source.read())
        self.records.put('ATTEMPT-new-JSON-stage.actual.json', {'names': [item.target for item in supplements],
            'old52_restaged': False, 'maximum_invocations': 1})
        self.counts['supplement_stage'] += 1
        self.command('stage-only-new-JSON', self.git(W, ['add', '--', *[item.target for item in supplements]]), mutation=True)
        combined = (*self.plan.items, *supplements)
        combined_table = self.verify_stage(combined, 'combined')
        old_bytes = self.command('old52-after-supplements', self.git(W, ['cat-file', '--batch']),
            ('\n'.join(':'+item.target for item in self.plan.items)+'\n').encode())
        p.need(p.parse_batch(old_bytes, self.plan.items) == original_table, 'old52 bytes changed')
        self.clean_check(names)
        self.phase = 'commit'
        self.records.put('ATTEMPT-commit.actual.json', {'maximum_invocations': 1})
        self.counts['commit'] += 1
        self.command('commit', self.git(W, ['commit', '-m', p.text(self.cap.get('commit_message'), 'commit message')]), mutation=True)
        head = self.command('committed-HEAD', self.git(W, ['rev-parse', 'HEAD'])).decode().strip()
        data = self.command('committed-blobs', self.git(W, ['cat-file', '--batch']),
                            ('\n'.join(head+':'+item.target for item in combined)+'\n').encode())
        p.need(p.parse_batch(data, combined) == combined_table, 'committed byte proof')
        p.ledger_check(json.loads(self.command('ledger', self.git(W, ['show', head+':'+
            'promo/ck3_native_war_ai/episode-04-march-logistics/review02/r0175-r12-positive-review-a01/formal-dynamic-theme-ledger.json']))), 8)
        p.need(self.command('prepush-remote', self.git(W, ['ls-remote', 'origin', 'refs/heads/master'])).decode().split() == [BASE, 'refs/heads/master'],
               'remote advanced; do not push')
        self.phase = 'push'
        self.records.put('ATTEMPT-push.actual.json', {'maximum_invocations': 1, 'force': False})
        self.counts['push'] += 1
        self.command('push', self.git(W, ['push', 'origin', 'HEAD:refs/heads/master']), mutation=True)
        p.need(self.command('final-remote', self.git(W, ['ls-remote', 'origin', 'refs/heads/master'])).decode().split() == [head, 'refs/heads/master'], 'remote readback')
        p.need(not self.command('final-clean', self.git(W, ['status', '--porcelain=v1', '--untracked-files=all'])), 'final W clean')
        p.need(not self.command('final-D-clean', self.git(D, ['status', '--porcelain=v1', '--untracked-files=no'])), 'final D clean')
        self.records.put('FINAL.actual.json', {'status': 'PUBLISHED_EXACT_KNOWN52_PLUS_LF_SUPPLEMENTS', 'HEAD': head,
            'counts': self.counts, 'original52_unchanged': True, 'total_items': len(combined),
            'ordered_blob_table_sha256': combined_table, 'W_clean': True, 'D_frozen': True,
            'remote_exact': True, 'owned_processes': [], 'formal': '8/11 unchanged'})


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    modes = parser.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    modes.add_argument('--financial', type=Path)
    modes.add_argument('--admission', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--sha256', required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    path = Path(args.admission if args.admission is not None else args.financial).resolve()
    pin = p.Pin(path, path.stat().st_size, p.digest(args.sha256, 64, 'card SHA'))
    runner = Runner(pin, args.admission is not None)
    try:
        runner.finish() if runner.execution else runner.inspect()
    except BaseException as error:
        runner.records.put('STOPPED.actual.json', {'status': 'STOPPED_NO_REPLAY', 'phase': runner.phase,
            'counts': runner.counts, 'error': type(error).__name__+': '+str(error)[:2048], 'owned_processes': []})
        return 1
    return 0


if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
